huggingface.summary: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. huggingface.summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons.
